markdown-editor.name: Markdown Editor
markdown-editor.headline:
Big ideas.
Blank page.
markdown-editor.description: Write Markdown, see it take shape, and keep your documents on your device. Your next draft starts here.
markdown-editor.seo: Markdown Editor: Offline Notes & Live Preview | Coffee & Fun
markdown-editor.meta: Write Markdown with live preview, local documents, version history, math and diagrams. Free browser extensions and an Apple app from Coffee & Fun.
markdown-editor.imageAlt: Markdown Editor with source text on the left, a live preview on the right, and an optional pet cat.
markdown-editor.caption: The actual editor, with the night theme and a little company.
markdown-editor.os: macOS, iOS, iPadOS, Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari
markdown-editor.note: Free browser extensions · Apple app sold separately
steps: Make yourself at home.
Install the extension or Apple app and start a document. No account to create.
Find your flow.
Write on one side and see your formatted page on the other. Use the toolbar or keyboard shortcuts.
Take your words with you.
Download Markdown, export HTML, print, or back up your library as a ZIP.
features: Write. Preview. Done.
Formatting shortcuts, live preview, and an outline that keeps up.
More than plain text.
Tables, equations, diagrams. Eight themes to make it yours.
Yours to keep.
Local documents, version history, and one-click backups.
markdown-editor.panelText: Documents are stored locally on your device. Export a backup when you need one. Sharing a document with another service is something you choose.
faqs: Is Markdown Editor free?
The Chrome, Edge, and Firefox extensions are free. The app for Mac, iPhone, and iPad is a separate one-time purchase with the Safari extension included. See the App Store for your local price.
Can I write offline?
Yes. Editing, previewing, and your document library work on your device without an internet connection.
Can I recover an earlier draft?
Automatic version history keeps snapshots while you write. You can also export individual documents or back up the whole library as a ZIP.
What can I write?
GitHub-flavored Markdown, including tables and task lists, plus footnotes, front matter, KaTeX math, and Mermaid diagrams.
Are the playful effects required?
No. The cat, sounds, and other toys are optional and off by default.
markdown-editor.heroNote: Words first. Everything else can wait.
markdown-editor.tagline: A little space for big ideas.

procrastinot.name: ProcrastiNOT
procrastinot.headline:
Focus looks
good on you.
procrastinot.description: Block distracting websites in Safari. Solve a little math when you’re ready to turn blocking off.
procrastinot.seo: ProcrastiNOT: Website Blocker for Safari | Coffee & Fun
procrastinot.meta: Block distracting websites in Safari with ProcrastiNOT. Choose your block list and solve a math problem to turn blocking off. For Mac, iPhone and iPad.
procrastinot.caption: A little help for the thing you meant to do.
steps: Pick your distractions.
Add the websites you want a little distance from.
Make room for your work.
When you visit a blocked site, ProcrastiNOT redirects you with a reminder to refocus.
Pause before unblocking.
Solve a math problem to turn blocking off. Or leave it on and get back to your task.
features: Pick your distractions.
Add the sites that keep pulling you away.
Leave the block on.
A reminder sends you back to what you meant to do.
Ready for a break?
Solve a math problem to turn blocking off.
procrastinot.panelTitle:
A little friction.
A little more intention.
procrastinot.panelText: You decide what to block. ProcrastiNOT gives you a moment to think before opening the sites you chose to avoid.
faqs: How do I unblock a website?
Solve the math problem to turn blocking off. You stay in control of your block list.
Which devices can I use?
ProcrastiNOT is available for Safari on Mac, iPhone, and iPad. Check the App Store for current compatibility.
What permissions does it use?
Navigation and tab permissions let the extension redirect blocked sites. Storage keeps your preferences and block list on your device.
Where can I get help?
Visit our support page or email hello@coffeeandfun.com. Tell us your device, Safari version, and what happened.
downloads: Get ProcrastiNOT on the App Store
procrastinot.tagline: A little pause. A little more focus.

hide-spoilers-extension.name: Hide Spoilers
hide-spoilers-extension.headline:
Don’t tell
me yet.
hide-spoilers-extension.description: Keep the plot twist a surprise. Blur matching words, images, and thumbnails until you’re ready.
hide-spoilers-extension.seo: Hide Spoilers: Blur Spoilers in Chrome & Safari | Coffee & Fun
hide-spoilers-extension.meta: Avoid spoilers with Hide Spoilers for Chrome and Safari. Add keywords and phrases to blur matching text, images and video thumbnails while you browse.
hide-spoilers-extension.caption: For the episode you haven’t watched. Yet.
steps: Make your list.
Add show titles, character names, games, or phrases you would rather not see yet.
Go about your browsing.
Matching text, images, and thumbnails are blurred on supported pages.
Catch up, then clear up.
Remove keywords when you are ready to see the conversation again.
features: Name your nemesis.
Add show titles, characters, games, or whole phrases.
Browse with a buffer.
Matching text and thumbnails get blurred.
All caught up?
Remove the keywords. Join the conversation.
hide-spoilers-extension.panelTitle:
Enjoy the story.
At your own pace.
hide-spoilers-extension.panelText: Keyword matching helps you avoid spoilers, but it cannot catch every reference. Website layouts and unlabelled images can affect what gets hidden.
faqs: How does it work?
The extension checks page content against the keywords and phrases you choose, then blurs matching sections.
Does it work on every website?
It works on many sites, including social feeds and video pages, but results depend on how the page is built. It cannot guarantee every spoiler will be hidden.
Can I change the keywords?
Yes. Add or remove words and phrases whenever you want.
Is it free?
Hide Spoilers is free on Chrome and Safari.
hide-spoilers-extension.heroNote: For the episode you haven’t watched.

immersive-reader.meta: Coming soon: Immersive Reader for Safari by Coffee & Fun. Text-to-speech, adjustable text, focus and translation tools for Mac, iPhone and iPad.

immersive-reader.note: Coming soon for Mac, iPhone & iPad

Open something to read.

Find your reading rhythm.
Adjust the text, choose a voice, or use line focus to follow along.

Adjust type, spacing, colors, and line focus.

faqs: Can I download it yet?
Not yet. Immersive Reader for Safari is coming soon. We will add the download link here when it is ready.
Does it work offline?
No. An internet connection is required for the reading services.
Which devices is it designed for?
Immersive Reader is being developed for Safari on Mac, iPhone, and iPad. Final compatibility details will be available at launch.
Is this a Microsoft app?
No. Coffee & Fun LLC develops this app independently. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft.
Will there be a subscription?
Yes. Reading features will require a subscription. Final pricing and terms will be shown when the app launches.
immersive-reader.tagline: Make room for your kind of reading.

instant-incognito.name: Instant Incognito
instant-incognito.headline:
A private
entrance.
instant-incognito.description: Selected sites, straight into an incognito window. An earlier Coffee & Fun project, kept here for existing users.
instant-incognito.seo: Instant Incognito: Retired Browser Extension | Coffee & Fun
instant-incognito.meta: Instant Incognito opens chosen websites in private windows. This retired Coffee & Fun extension remains documented here with setup help for existing users.
instant-incognito.caption: A small helper from our earlier brews.
steps: Choose your sites.
Add the websites you want to open in a private window.
Browse as usual.
The extension checks whether the page matches your list.
Continue in incognito.
Matching websites open in a private browsing window.
features: Choose your sites.
Save a list of websites on your device.
Let it switch.
Matching pages open in a private window.
Know the limits.
Incognito limits local browser history. It doesn’t make you anonymous.
instant-incognito.panelText: Incognito mode limits what your browser saves locally. It does not make you anonymous to websites, your network provider, your school, or your employer.
faqs: Is Instant Incognito still maintained?
Instant Incognito is retired. Existing users can still find its documentation here, but continued browser compatibility is not guaranteed.
Can I still contribute?
No. Contributions are closed for this retired project.
What permissions does it need?
Navigation and tab permissions let it recognize listed sites and open a private window. Storage saves your settings locally.
Does incognito make me anonymous?
No. Private browsing does not hide your traffic from the sites you visit or the network you use.
instant-incognito.closing: Looking for your next little helper.
instant-incognito.tagline: A private window, right on cue.

stillkeys.name: Stillkeys
stillkeys.tagline: A little pause. A cleaner keyboard.

stillkeys.seo: Stillkeys: Disable Typing to Clean Your Mac Keyboard

Give your keys some care.
The cleaning screen catches ordinary typing. Your mouse and trackpad stay available.
Back when you’re ready.

Typing is captured immediately, with three seconds to get ready.

stillkeys.panelText: Stillkeys works entirely on your Mac. What you type isn’t saved, recorded, or sent anywhere. No accounts, ads, analytics, or keystroke history.
stillkeys.closing: A fresh start for your keys.
